turnos.pregunta: Two-storey stairwell, old paper on it, probably needs removing first.
consultas: Two-storey stairwell, old paper on it, probably needs removing first.
turnos.respuesta:
Removal is the part of a job that's hardest to judge from a distance — how the old paper comes off depends on what's underneath it and how it was originally hung, and that sometimes turns up repair work no one could see beforehand. A two-storey stairwell also means working at height over a stair run, so it's worth someone seeing it.

Whenever you're ready, I can pass your details along and the team can take a look — no pressure while you're still just looking.
